messages.author: 833403426642d6ee
messages.subject: specifying Argos errors in CTMM
parts:
Hello,

I'm new to the CTMM package and I'm a bit confused. I have a lot of Argos tracking data for penguins. I have Argos error information (location classes for older data, error ellipses for newer data). Can I use those error fields in the CTMM package to help select and fit models, and if so, how? 

I formatted the data like the MoveBank format, including columns for either Argos.location.class or Argos.semi.major, Argos.semi.minor, and Argos.orientation (one or the other within a given file).

With the error ellipse data, I get the following message from as.telemetry (it runs without error if I use a version of the file without the error fields):
 Error in `[[<-.data.frame`(`*tmp*`, DOP.LIST$horizontal$VAR, value = numeric(0)) : 
  replacement has 0 rows, data has 356 

With the location classes, as.telemetry runs with this message (which seems OK; 48321 is the penguin ID):
ARGOS error ellipses not found. Using location class estimates from McClintock et al (2015).
Minimum sampling interval of 25 seconds in 48321

But then variogram gives me this error (if I use a file without location classes, it runs without error):
 Error in `$<-.data.frame`(`*tmp*`, "SVF", value = 0) : 
  replacement has 1 row, data has 0 

All the examples I've found use GPS data, not Argos.
Thanks in advance. I appreciate any help.

Ginger

messages.author: 40fd627580dd34f5
messages.subject: Re: specifying Argos errors in CTMM
parts:
Hi Ginger,

ARGOS data, either old or new, should work like pre-calibrated data in ctmm, but with error ellipses instead of error circles. There are some GPS examples in vignette('error') and ARGOS data is coded to work similarly.

Do you mind messaging or emailing a copy of data that can reproduce these errors?

Best,
Chris

messages.author: 40fd627580dd34f5
messages.subject: Re: specifying Argos errors in CTMM
parts:
Hi Ginger,

The newer ARGOS data with error ellipses imported fine for me in the development version of the package (on GitHub), which you can install via devtools::install_github("ctmm-initiative/ctmm") .

The older ARGOS data had some location class "Z" data, that I had to code to remove and works now if you update the package from GitHub.

Best,
Chris
